title: Rust FragmentSender accepts unauthenticated ACK and abort controls
description: rust/lichen-schc FragmentSender.handle_ack_bytes accepts raw bytes with no AuthenticatedFrame/Link evidence and can mark an authenticated transfer succeeded/aborted or trigger retransmission. Policy-at-construction does not authenticate ongoing controls. Require exact current Link-owned signer/local-target/generation/replay evidence for ACK/Receiver-Abort, bind it to the active session/window, and reject raw/foreign/replayed/stale controls without mutation. Add authenticated production integration and shared vectors.
notes:
Final correctness review: handle_ack_bytes() and handle_ack(Ack) remain public and mutate authenticated sender state without Link evidence. Production wrappers do not prevent callers from bypassing them. Make raw parser/state transition private or separate an unprivileged codec type that cannot own an authenticated session.
Independent security review confirms public handle_ack_bytes/handle_ack can terminate or retransmit an authenticated session from unauthenticated bytes; raw state ownership must be unreachable from production callers.
